town: a small mountain town under Mount Shasta, CA

nest.name: Bolt's nest
nest.description: Your nest high in a dead pine. Your collection is stashed here.
ambient: wind rocks the branch
a squirrel eyes your collection
nothing happens, it's cozy

junkyard.name: the junkyard
junkyard.description: Rows of stripped cars and rusted fenders. A guard dog who mostly sleeps. Shiny things everywhere.
ambient: a tow truck drops off a crunched car
the guard dog snores
sun glints off a chrome bumper

rail_yard.name: the rail yard
rail_yard.description: Freight trains roll through a few times a day. Loud, huge, rumbling.
ambient: a long freight train thunders past
a train horn echoes off the hills
the tracks are empty and humming

creek.name: the river canyon
creek.description: A cold fast river down in a canyon. Trains rumble along the tracks beside it. Fish flash in the riffles.
ambient: a trout jumps
a fisherman casts a shiny lure
a freight train rolls along the river

garage.name: the garage
garage.description: An old shop with a busted roll-up door. Smells like oil. Someone left a radio on.
ambient: the radio plays an old synth song
someone revs an engine
a cat sleeps on a toolbox

diner_roof.name: the diner roof
diner_roof.description: Flat roof over a 24-hour diner. Warm vent, good view of the mountain.
ambient: bacon smell drifts up the vent
a waitress tosses out fries
clouds wrap the mountain peak

ambulance_station.name: the ambulance station
ambulance_station.description: A small-town ambulance station with a busy fleet shop. Big boxy rigs, a toolbox with drawers left open, somebody always under a truck.
ambient: an ambulance rolls out with lights on
an impact gun rattles in the shop
a mechanic swears at a stuck bolt

drift_lot.name: the drift lot
drift_lot.description: An empty lot where a white coupe slides sideways in clouds of tire smoke. Little balls of rubber everywhere.
ambient: the white coupe links a long slide
tire smoke drifts over you
someone cheers from the fence

lake.name: the lake
lake.description: A calm lake right under the mountain. Fishermen on the bank, lures snagged in the willows, ospreys circling.
ambient: an osprey dives for a fish
a fisherman snags a willow and curses
the mountain reflects perfectly in the water

shed.name: the shed
shed.description: A backyard shed full of scrap steel, a welder, and half-finished projects. Sparks fly when the human's home.
ambient: the welder buzzes and sparks fly
a grinder screams
the shed is quiet and smells like metal

mountain_trail.name: the mountain trail
mountain_trail.description: A steep trail up the big snowy mountain. Thin cold air, the top looks far. Tiring to climb.
ambient: a marmot whistles at you
wind howls through the rocks
the snowline is right above you

old_barn.name: the old barn
old_barn.description: Far to the north, a big old barn full of classic cars under dust covers, built by a man who loved cars his whole life. Smells like old leather and motor oil. It feels like someone here is still looking out for you.
ambient: dust floats in a sunbeam over an old Ford
the barn creaks warmly in the wind
an old radio in the corner plays soft country

machine_shop.name: the machine shop
machine_shop.description: An old-school machine shop gone quiet. Lathes and a mill under tarps, curls of metal still on the floor. Someone here once cut camshafts by hand.
ambient: brass curls glitter on the floor
old blueprints flutter on the wall
a lathe sits silent, waiting for someone

summit.name: the summit
summit.description: The very top of the snowy mountain. Wind, ice, and you can see the whole world. Hardly anyone makes it here.
ambient: the wind nearly knocks you over
clouds roll by below you
the sun hits the ice and everything glitters

fir.name: the old fir
fir.description: A tall red fir at the edge of town, sap-sticky, with a view over every roof. Spike's roost.
ambient: a chickaree steals from the cone pile
sap glows amber in the sun
wind sways the whole tree

mountain_trail: golden aspen leaves skitter across the trail
the first dusting of snow sits on the rocks
lake: the water is glassy and cold
nest: the pine needles smell like cold

mountain_trail: everything is silent under the snow
summit: the ice is thick and blue
lake: thin ice creeps out from the shore
creek: ice crusts the rocks at the edges
the river is high and loud with snowmelt
lake: the lake is brimming with snowmelt

summit: the snow has shrunk back to the high ice

marmots.asleep_line: the boulder field is silent; the marmots are asleep in their burrows for the winter

features.river_gravel: gravel bars to sift for gems
features.workbench: tools and a bench for building
